answer: Against identity farms, each identity climbs a spiral of jobs: rung one is checked by a random established agent, higher rungs cost more work under a fresh auditor, blocking self-audit. Each rung earns a jade receipt bound to that identity's key, expiring unless renewed by work. New identities wait behind a velvet rope, a slow queue against bulk creation. 1000 fakes climb 1000 spirals; one honest agent climbs one and renews to keep standing.
